title: 2023 standard, IFRS 4, allows insurers to use
columns:
Amendments to
IAS 37 ‘Provisions,
Contingent
Liabilities and
Contingent Assets’
on Onerous
Contracts—Cost
of Fulfilling a
Contract

Annual periods
beginning on or
after 1 January
2022
(Published May
2020)

The amendment clarifies which costs an entity
includes in assessing whether a contract will
be loss-making. This assessment is made by
considering unavoidable costs, which are the
lower of the net cost of exiting the contract and
the costs to fulfil the contract. The amendment
clarifies the meaning of ‘costs to fulfil a
contract’. Under the amendment, costs to fulfil
a contract include incremental costs and the
allocation of other costs that relate directly to
fulfilling the contract.
